title: Pranit More: DO VEGANS GIVE BLO*JOB?

overview: Pranit More, a prominent figure in the Indian stand-up comedy scene, has recently released a unique crowd work special that showcases his spontaneous humor and sharp wit. This special is a departure from traditional stand-up routines, focusing entirely on real-time interactions with diverse audience members.
